title: business opportunities - u.s. embassy in cambodia
paragraphs: the u.s. embassy phnom penh is a large procurement operation, processing approximately 6 million dollars in annual acquisitions from several agencies of the u.s. mission in cambodia. our mission is to ensure that the government’s requirements for goods and services are acquired in a manner consistent with u.s. laws and regulations by ensuring that the u.s. government meets its requirements at the best price and value. please be informed that requests for quotations of goods and services over usd 15,000 will be posted on the u.s. embassy website in the business opportunities site. this page contains information on all current solicitations and downloadable documents. vendors interested in providing quotations are welcomed to visit this page from time to time to seek business opportunities with the u.s. embassy phnom penh. click here (pdf: 5 mb) to download the instructions/guidance for international entity registration in sam.gov (khmer and english). the procurement section of the general service office, u.s. embassy phnom penh, may be reached by contacting the following: phone: (855) 23 728 000 fax: (855) 23 728 600 e-mail address: phnompenhprocurement@state.gov
the u.s. embassy phnom penh is a large procurement operation, processing approximately 6 million dollars in annual acquisitions from several agencies of the u.s. mission in cambodia.

our mission is to ensure that the government’s requirements for goods and services are acquired in a manner consistent with u.s. laws and regulations by ensuring that the u.s. government meets its requirements at the best price and value.

please be informed that requests for quotations of goods and services over usd 15,000 will be posted on the u.s. embassy website in the business opportunities site. this page contains information on all current solicitations and downloadable documents. vendors interested in providing quotations are welcomed to visit this page from time to time to seek business opportunities with the u.s. embassy phnom penh.
